results.title: Focus Bear - Monash Innovation
results.content:
Focus Bear is a productivity app designed to support individuals with ADHD and Autism (ASD), conditions that affect over 5% of Australian adults and significantly impact productivity and employment. Research shows adults with ADHD are up to 40% less productive than neurotypical peers, with unemployment rates four times higher. Focus Bear addresses these challenges by managing distractions, building routines, and improving punctuality.

The app works across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, using AI to block irrelevant websites or apps during work. It nudges users from impulsive “System 1” thinking to deliberate “System 2” decision-making, inspired by Daniel Kahneman’s Thinking, Fast and Slow. Users set time limits and intentions for distractions, ensuring mindful engagement. [...] Focus Bear enhances focus through guided morning routines incorporating mindfulness and exercise, proven to boost concentration. The “Late No More” feature issues escalating notifications to prevent tardiness. Additional features include distraction blocking, habit tracking, and personalized feedback using integrated data.

Developed by a team with lived experience of ADHD/ASD, Focus Bear recently received a $200k NDIA grant to expand its functionality for students with disabilities. The app offers a structured, accessible solution to improve productivity and quality of life for neurodivergent individuals.

Focus Bear Home Page

FocusBear is an innovative productivity app specifically designed for people with ADHD and ASD, developed by a team with personal experience in neurodivergence. The app aims to reduce decision fatigue and distraction by guiding users through their daily routines with real-time habit guides, blocking distracting sites and apps across all devices, and utilizing AI to maintain focus. Key features include personalized habit routines, productivity-boosting breaks, customizable focus modes, and automatic goal tracking. The app supports users in establishing healthy morning and evening routines, enhancing productivity at work, and ensuring quality time for relaxation and sleep.
